input.body: We are writing to request a review of the $14.25 deduction on order DD-51123, dated 2026-11-05, which was applied with the reason "missing item" (Veg Momo (Fried)). The order ticket for DD-51123 lists 'Veg Momo (Fried)', which shows the order was prepared as placed [DD-51123:ticket_lists_item]. We recognise these records do not show the contents of the bag at handoff, and we are sharing only what our records show.
